days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Saas-Grund
stops.detail: Saas-Grund is the former main town of the Saas Valley and the second largest town in the Saas Valley after Saas-Fee.

stops.name: Weissmies
stops.detail: On the right side of the Saas Valley are the two four-thousand-meter peaks of the Weissmies group, Weissmies and Lagginhorn; 36 four-thousand-meter peaks surround the Matter Valley.

stops.name: Hohsaas
stops.detail: The village has a sunny skiing and hiking area (Hohsaas, Kreuzboden) and is – like the rest of the Saas Valley – geared towards tourism.

stops.name: Mattmark-Staudamm
stops.detail: Immediately adjacent to Saas-Almagell is the Mattmark Dam, the highest earth-fill dam in Europe (2197 m).

stops.name: Eisten
stops.detail: Coming from the Rhone Valley via Visp and Stalden, you first reach Eisten and Saas-Balen, then Saas-Grund.
